name: ANSI/IEEE normally open pushbutton symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for normally open pushbutton, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The momentary NO pushbutton form associates an operator action with an initially open contact. Read the actuator and contact together, then identify the control path that becomes continuous while the button is operated.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Keep the operator's release action separate from any electrical holding circuit.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A momentary pushbutton returns mechanically; a latched pushbutton retains its position.
